stories.title: Rams suffer several major injuries, including to WR Adams, who's out 6-10 weeks
stories.summary: Rams wideout Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced.
stories.detail: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's home loss to the Arizona Cardinals , and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced Monday. It wasn't the only major injury suffered by a significant Rams player Sunday. Poona Ford will miss the rest of the season with a ruptured triceps, and fellow defensive tackle Kobie Turner will be out four to six weeks because of a groin injury. In addition, kicker Blake Grupe suffered a torn ACL in the contest, and he will be sidelined for the remainder of the campaign. The Rams had just signed Grupe last week after releasing the struggling Harrison Mevis . The injuries are the latest hits for a Rams team that entered the season as Super Bowl favorites but sits at 2-4 after six weeks. Star defensive end Myles Garrett has played just one game for the team after he was acquired in a blockbuster offseason trade. Garrett, who is on injured reserve due to a knee injury, will not return to practice this week, McVay said.

stories.title: John Harbaugh: Giants 'honing in on' QB decision for Sunday vs. Texans
stories.summary: The Giants are "honing in on" a decision on who will start at quarterback for Sunday's game against the Texans, coach John Harbaugh said Monday.
stories.detail: EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- The New York Giants were unwilling to name a starting quarterback one day after J.J. McCarthy almost completed a miraculous comeback in relief of Jameis Winston against the New Orleans Saints . Coach John Harbaugh is choosing between McCarthy and Winston for Sunday on the road against the Houston Texans . "We're working through that now," Harbaugh said Monday. "Honing in on a decision." McCarthy, who came to the Giants in a trade with the Minnesota Vikings late last month, threw for 243 yards after entering the game with just under 12 minutes remaining. It was the second-most passing yards in a fourth quarter by a quarterback who didn't start over the past 25 years. McCarthy led three scoring drives and had the Giants in the red zone before falling short in the final seconds of a 34-27 loss to the Saints. Winston was unbeaten coming into Sunday in three starts for the Giants this season. He threw for 152 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions against the Saints. Harbaugh is trying to figure out who gives the Giants the best chance to beat a Texans team with a fierce pass rush. Houston is third in the NFL with 18 sacks. The Giants (3-2-1) have a bye w…

stories.title: Rams place kicker Blake Grupe on IR due to knee injury
stories.summary: The Rams have placed kicker Blake Grupe on injured reserve after he injured his right knee in the team's Week 6 loss to the Cardinals.
stories.detail: LOS ANGELES -- The Los Angeles Rams have placed kicker Blake Grupe on injured reserve after he injured his right knee in the team's Week 6 loss to the Arizona Cardinals , the team announced Monday. Coach Sean McVay said that Grupe has a torn ACL. The Rams have not announced a corresponding move at kicker. Grupe was playing in his first game with Los Angeles after he was signed off the New York Jets ' practice squad last week. Grupe was signed to replace Harrison Mevis , who missed a 50-yard field goal attempt and then had a 48-yarder blocked in overtime of the Rams' Week 5 loss to the Buffalo Bills . But after making a 44-yard field goal in the opening quarter Sunday, Grupe hurt his right knee on the ensuing kickoff while trying to make a tackle. After the game, Grupe was in the locker room with a big brace on his right leg and crutches at his locker. The Rams play the Raiders in Las Vegas in Week 7.

stories.title: Patriots place WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) on IR
stories.summary: The Patriots have placed Romeo Doubs on IR.
stories.detail: FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- Just as the New England Patriots welcomed back top receiver A.J. Brown from injured reserve, they've lost another top receiver, Romeo Doubs , to a shoulder injury. The club officially placed Doubs on injured reserve Monday, one day after he landed hard on his right shoulder while making a diving 42-yard touchdown catch in a 26-19 win over the New York Jets . Doubs, who left the game after the touchdown and didn't return, has 14 receptions for 261 yards and three touchdowns this season, his first in New England. He will miss at least the next four games, beginning Thursday night when the Patriots (4-2) visit the Chicago Bears (4-2) at Soldier Field. New England then visits the Miami Dolphins and hosts the Green Bay Packers before facing the Detroit Lions in Munich. Its bye week follows. Injuries have been a defining characteristic of the Patriots' 2026 campaign, beginning in the spring when they lost No. 2 tight end Julian Hill to a season-ending knee injury. Others placed on IR during the season include starting right guard Mike Onwenu (ankle) and his replacement, Greg Van Roten (hip), No. 3 offensive tackle Marcus Bryant (ankle), starting fullback Reggie Gill…

stories.summary: The veteran wide receiver will be out for at least the next four weeks.
stories.detail: Romeo Doubs’ sixth game as a member of the New England Patriots was a brief affair. The offseason signing played only two snaps, the second of which a 42-yard touchdown catch that saw him remain down with a shoulder injury. The ailment kept him out of the remainder of the game, and will now sideline him for a minimum of four additional contests: as the team announced on Monday, Doubs has been placed on injured reserve . This means the Patriots will be without their high-prized free agency signing against the Chicago Bears, Miami Dolphins, Green Bay Packers and Detroit Lions, if not longer. What else does the move mean for New England? Let’s assess. stories.title: Jalen Hurts expected to miss season after blood clots discovered in QB's lungs
stories.summary: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in his lungs, according to NFL Network and ESPN.
stories.detail: Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in the Philadelphia Eagles quarterback's lungs, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter. Hurts will undergo treatment involving blood thinners that is expected to sideline the three-time Pro Bowler for at least three months, sources informed of the diagnosis told Rapoport and Schefter. Hurts' agent, Nicole Lynn, and the Eagles released a statement Monday detailing Hurts' condition. Lynn and the Eagles said Hurts has deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli, meaning a blood clot traveled from his legs to his lungs. Hurts is "clinically stable and has no significant functional limitations," according to the statement, but will not be allowed to participate in football activities while on anticoagulation medication. "Jalen's prognosis is very good, and we expect a full recovery," the statement said. "We anticipate that he will have the opportunity to resume contact football activities when off the blood thinners. In the meantime, he will remain active around the team and continue to condition. stories.title: Hornets, Brandon Miller agree to 5-year, $209M rookie extension
stories.summary: The Hornets and forward Brandon Miller agreed to a five-year, $209 million rookie-scale contract extension.
stories.detail: Charlotte Hornets forward Brandon Miller has agreed to a five-year, $209 million rookie-scale contract extension, representatives AJ Vaynerchuk and Joey Middleton of VaynerSports told ESPN's Shams Charania on Monday. Miller, who turns 24 next month, had a career season last year, averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds and 38.3% shooting from 3 in 65 regular-season games. He was also able to stay mostly healthy following a season in which he appeared in just 27 games. Miller, along with then-rookie Kon Knueppel , helped spearhead a surprise run to the postseason in the second half of last year, where they fell in the second play-in game. He was especially key to Charlotte's midseason turnaround, as the Hornets went 41-24 with Miller available and 3-14 without him. He missed a chunk of the beginning of the season due to a shoulder injury. Miller underwent surgery in May to address the stability of that shoulder but he has since fully recovered and appeared in preseason for Charlotte. Heading into his fourth year in the league, Miller will be stepping into an even bigger role for the Hornets this season after the team traded away longtime franchise staples LaMelo Ball and Miles Bridges …

stories.title: Lakers make final roster decision, waive Dalton Knecht as Bronny stays
stories.summary: Why Dalton Knecht's release felt inevitable as the preseason came to a close. Here's what we know about Lakers final roster move.
stories.detail: The Los Angeles Lakers have come to a decision on their roster to open the season. Dalton Knecht has been waived, the team announced Monday afternoon. The move puts the Lakers roster at 15 players, the limit under NBA rules. The Lakers, who carried 16 players through the preseason, had a choice to make between Knecht and Bronny James. Both players were held out of practice ahead of Monday's 2 p.m. cut deadline, with head coach JJ Redick saying the two cut candidates were "under the weather." And despite rumors over the weekend of trade talks centered around Knecht, it appears president of basketball operations Rob Pelinka ultimately decided to make a clean break. Lakers waive Dalton Knecht The problem that comes with trading a player who won't make the roster comes down to value. Teams have no reason to give up any assets for a guy they know they can get for nothing a few days later. Pelinka has shown over the years that he's particular about return packages; he's more than willing to pass on a trade if he's not 100% sure it would improve the roster. stories.title: Hornets, Brandon Miller reportedly agree to $209M contract extension ahead of Monday's deadline
stories.summary: The two sides agreed to the deal Monday, hours ahead of a deadline for players from Miller’s draft class to sign an extension.
stories.detail: The Charlotte Hornets and Brandon Miller have agreed to a five-year, $209 million extension to his rookie contract, ESPN’s Shams Charania reports — a deal cementing the No. 2 overall pick in the 2023 NBA Draft as one of the cornerstones of the ongoing effort to build a consistent contender in the Queen City. The two sides agreed to the deal Monday, hours ahead of a deadline for players from Miller’s draft class to sign an extension. Had they not reached agreement on a deal, Miller would have played the upcoming season on a team option, then gone into next offseason as a restricted free agent. Instead, Miller is under contract for five more seasons at $41.8 million per year after playing the first four seasons of his rookie contract for a total of $49.4 million. The former Alabama standout bounced back from an injury-wracked sophomore season to turn in a stellar third campaign, averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.0 steals in 30.3 minutes per game with a career-best .574 true shooting percentage (which factors in 2-point, 3-point and free-throw accuracy). stories.summary: The Lakers selected Dalton Knecht with a first-round draft pick in 2024.
stories.detail: Dalton Knecht’s run with the Los Angeles Lakers is over. The Lakers waived Knecht on Monday, just two days before they officially open the 2026-27 NBA season, the team announced. The decision came just before the league’s deadline for teams to finalize their opening-day regular season rosters. As a result, both Bronny James and Jaden Hardy made the Lakers’ opening-day roster. James, Hardy and Knecht were widely considered the best options for the Lakers to cut to get to the 15-player maximum after they entered training camp with one too many players. The Lakers selected Knecht with the No. 17 overall pick in 2024 out of Tennessee. He was a solid bench player for the franchise as a rookie, too, averaging 9.1 points and 2.8 rebounds in about 19 minutes per game off the bench. The Lakers actually cut a deal to trade him to the Charlotte Hornets ahead of the deadline in 2025, too. But that trade, which was done so the Lakers could acquire center Mark Williams, fell through after Williams failed his physical. So Knecht went back to Los Angeles, and has been there ever since. stories.title: Warriors expect Steph Curry (ankle) to play in opener vs. Lakers
stories.summary: The Warriors expect Stephen Curry to be available for Wednesday night's season opener against the Lakers despite tweaking his right ankle during an open scrimmage Sunday.
stories.detail: The Golden State Warriors expect Stephen Curry to be available for Wednesday night's season opener against the Los Angeles Lakers despite tweaking his right ankle during an open scrimmage Sunday afternoon. Curry was a full participant in practice Monday morning, and Warriors coach Steve Kerr said Curry reassured him he was "fine" soon after leaving the floor in clear discomfort. Curry rolled his ankle on a dribble move from the right wing midway through the scrimmage. After the misstep, he stopped action, banged the basketball on the floor and limped to the locker room in front of a concerned arena of teammates and fans. He didn't return to the scrimmage. But Curry's ankle responded well overnight, and the medical staff cleared him to continue his ramp-up to the regular season, expecting him to play against the Lakers on Wednesday after another practice Tuesday. Curry will turn 39 in March. He spent the summer reconfiguring his routine to better manage a persistent right knee problem that forced him to miss 27 games last season.
